title: Hermes Game Host Adapter Config
description: Data-driven mapping of game profiles to backend adapter scripts, process detection, and property types. Defines the approved boundary between declarative profiles and executable actions.

projectDir.description: Subdirectory under PROJECTS_ROOT containing this game's server files and scripts

commands.description: Approved actions mapped to script sequences. Each value is a list of [script, timeout] tuples.

propertyTypes.description: Map of server.properties keys to their types. Only keys listed here can be mutated via property.set.

statusCollector.description: How to collect live server status: minecraft_ping uses the MC server list protocol, steam_query uses Steam A2S_INFO, process_only just checks if the process is alive.

processSearch.description: Substring to search for in /proc/*/cmdline to detect if the server is running

defaultPort.description: Default game port for status display

portProtocol.description: Transport protocol for the game port

steamAppId.description: Steam AppID for SteamCMD updates (if applicable)
